new_note: Rounding limits the precision of a difference that is calculated from a long row. The core column prints 0.01 cycles per load. One printed step is 81.92 cycles per window at 8,192 loads and 655.36 cycles per window at 65,536 loads. The table uses the short rows for a more precise comparison. Each median is taken over the differences of the single rep rows. So the medians of two columns do not add up exactly to the median of their sum. The span time of a cme-call row is the sum of the spans of its 64 calls.
